senses.gloss:
अ- + ब्रह्मण्य अ- + ब्रह्मण्य,
 I. adj. 1. not fit for a Brāhmaṇa. 2. hostile to the Brāhmaṇas.
 II. n. 1. wickedness, a wicked act, Pañc. 101, 1. 2. an exclamation of distress, alas! woe! Pañc. 82, 18; murder, Kathās. 4, 111.
अ- + ब्रह्मन् अ- + ब्रह्मन्, adj. without Brāhmaṇas, Man. 9, 322.
अ- + ब्राह्मण अ- + ब्राह्मण, 1. m. one who is not a Brāhmaṇa, Man. 2, 241. 2. adj. without Brāhmaṇas.
